title: Synthetic case A: depression after job loss
Complaints: Alex, a 29-year-old graphic designer, reported three months of low mood, poor sleep, and loss of interest in drawing after being laid off. Alex described lying awake worrying about money, feeling exhausted during the day, and withdrawing from friends because of embarrassment about being unemployed.

title: Synthetic case B: panic after a car accident
Complaints: Sam, a 41-year-old nurse, described sudden episodes of racing heart, shortness of breath, and fear of dying that began after a car accident. Sam now avoids driving on highways and feels constantly on edge; the avoidance has made commuting to night shifts difficult.
